user.title: Solar Climate Manager
user.description: After adding, open Settings → Devices & services → Integrations → Solar Climate Manager and select the cog beside your entry to configure sources and limits. Change the operation mode on the device page.

sources.title: Data sources

data.load_includes_ac: House load includes the real AC
data.grid_on_means_available: Grid binary sensor ON means available
data.grid_import_limit_entity: Inverter grid import limit (number, optional; 0 = unlimited)

sources.description: Other settings and operation mode are preserved. The optional number import limit uses its W/kW unit automatically. A positive limit also requires an actual grid import/export power sensor.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.description: The target is for the room. The AC target compensates for the difference between its current_temperature and the room sensor. Other settings are preserved.

energy.title: Energy
energy.description: With grid available, low SOC allows operation if the import budget is sufficient and the battery is not materially discharging. Off-grid, minimum SOC is a hard limit.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Other technical settings are fixed: balance is assessed over 10 minutes; short load spikes are tolerated.
